title: Cutting sessions for visiting stars
summary: Chicago players tested visiting musicians in jam sessions.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: That happened many times. Some people used to call them cutting sessions (UNINTELLIGIBLE) -- they didn't know what it was about; they were just showing the person; saying, well, you're in my hometown; you know, you got to give me a little respect, too.

I appreciate you and I admire you -- you know, and you knock me out, but I got a little something to say, and they would say listen to this -- a lot of musicians, when they came through Chicago, they had to come, as we say, fully dressed.
They had somebody in Chicago for everybody, and so ...
